name: Floor Limit Type 1 Code
definition: Indicates whether the floor limit applies to credit, to debit or to both credit and debit entries.

CRED.name: Credit
CRED.definition: Floor limit applies to credit entries.

DEBT.name: Debit
DEBT.definition: Floor limit applies to debit entries.

BOTH.name: Both
BOTH.definition: Floor limit applies to both credit and debit entries.
